Method of Attack: Hacker sent emails containing racial slurs from Verificient Support account
Defacement of Verificient's website to display Rick Astley's 'Never Gonna Give You Up' video
Leaking of source code for various Verificient apps on Twitter and Telegram
Impacted Systems: Universities using ProctorTrack including Rutgers, University of Western Ontario, Ohio University, Illinois State University, Purdue University, MIT
Indicators of Compromise: Emails sent by hacker from Verificient Support account
Leaked source code on Twitter and Telegram
